import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int Maxn = (1 << 19) | 5;
    static int n, k, p, maxi;
    static int[] ct = new int[Maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp1 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp2 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static int[][] tmp3 = new int[20][Maxn];
    static long pp;
    static long[][] t = new long[20][Maxn];
    static long[] fac = new long[Maxn];
    static long[] inv = new long[Maxn];

    static long fast_pow(long x, long y) {
        long ans = 1, now = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) ans = ans * now % p;
            now = now * now % p;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static void init() {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxi; i++)
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % p;
        inv[maxi] = fast_pow(fac[maxi], p - 2);
        for (int i = maxi - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            inv[i] = inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
    }

    static int lower(int x) {
        int tmp = 1;
        for (; tmp < x; tmp <<= 1);
        return tmp;
    }

    static void FWT(int[] now, int len, boolean type) {
        long[] T = t[0];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) T[i] = now[i];
        if (type) {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] -= T[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i <<= 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j += (i << 1)) {
                    for (int k = j; k < i + j; k++) {
                        T[i + k] += T[k];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            now[i] = (int)(T[i] % p);
            if (now[i] < 0) now[i] += p;
        }
    }

    static void __a(long[] x, int idx) {
        if (x[idx] >= pp) x[idx] -= pp;
    }

    static void multi() {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++) {
            Arrays.fill(tmp1[j], 0);
            Arrays.fill(t[j], 0);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++)
            tmp1[ct[j]][j] = f[j];
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++)
            FWT(tmp1[j], maxi + 1, false);
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; l++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += 1L * tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                    __a(t, q + l, s);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp3[q][s] = (int)(t[q][s] % p);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= 19; j++)
            FWT(tmp3[j], maxi + 1, true);
        for (int j = 0; j <= maxi; j++)
            f[j] = tmp3[ct[j]][j];
    }

    static void multi2() {
        int[][] tmp = new int[20][Maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            Arrays.fill(t[i], 0);
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; l++) {
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                    t[q + l][s] += 1L * tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s];
                    __a(t, q + l, s);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; q++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxi; s++) {
                tmp[q][s] = (int)(t[q][s] % p);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            FWT(tmp[i], maxi + 1, true);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            Arrays.fill(tmp2[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxi; i++)
            tmp2[ct[i]][i] = tmp[ct[i]][i];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        pp = 1L * p * p;
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fast_pow(k, n));
            return;
        }
        f[0] = 1;
        maxi = lower(n + 1) - 1;
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxi; i++)
            ct[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxi; i++)
            tmp2[ct[i]][i] = (int)inv[i];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++)
            FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1, false);
        int res_k = k;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) multi();
            k >>= 1;
            if (k > 0) multi2();
        }
        long result = (fast_pow(res_k, n) - fac[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
